purpose: Define a generated, materialized Codex marketplace for every lifecycle plugin that preserves shared identity and portable contracts while allowing each harness to own its workflow design.
scope: Shared plugin identity, separately authored native Codex plugins, catalog runtime metadata, deterministic packaging, validation, CI, and installation and release documentation.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A Codex-native source tree exists for every marketplace plugin and has exact skill-name parity with its Claude source without requiring prompt-body reuse.

The generator produces a regular-file-only dist/codex bundle containing a valid .agents/plugins/marketplace.json and byte-identical copies of every authored native Codex manifest, skill, and resource.
Every Codex skill has a complete native single-agent workflow and treats agent-team delegation as an optional optimization for bounded independent work.

Validation rejects catalog parity drift, shared/native ID-version-author drift, stale generated output, symlinks, traversal paths, missing declared files, and unsafe runtime collisions without replacing a prior valid bundle.
Repository CI runs native source, generator, cross-harness contract, generated-drift, and repository-owned Codex manifest validation.
